name: simplepower
description: Simple Power is a Codex-only workflow with evolving-plan continuity, main-agent implementation by default, consent-gated grouped workers, mandatory verification, and read-only code discussion.

interface.shortDescription: Codex planning with main-agent default, plan continuity, and verification
interface.longDescription: Use Simple Power to guide Codex through brainstorming that creates one evolving authoritative plan, instruction-level compaction continuity in that plan, Main agent implementation by default, consent-gated Grouped workers only when brainstorming finds clear delegation value and the user agrees, an optional configured single-pass read-only plan reviewer limited to Critical and Must Fix findings, coordinator-led on-demand read-only explorer fan-out, mandatory quick verification run by the main agent by default or an optional FAST subagent with temporary local scratch refs, coordinator-only plan writes and grouped-worker progress snapshots, main-agent final diff review and in-scope fixes, concise execution summaries in original plans, two mandatory coordinator checkpoint types with bounded active-run execution commits, deprecated no-op compatibility validation for legacy review settings, terminal verification, and an explicit read-only code discussion mode.
defaultPrompt: I've got an idea for something I'd like to build with Codex.
Let's plan this work with Simple Power.
